notes: ACCESS: direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome124 impersonation) reached williams-sonoma.com's homepage and robots.txt (200) but every deeper /shop/ category URL returned Akamai 403 'Restricted Access' even with a warmed session (cookies from the homepage did not help) - likely a JS challenge (Akamai Bot Manager _abck) that a non-JS client can't solve. Playwright/Chromium headless hit the identical 403 on /shop/home/. robots.txt has no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot disallow (only EasouSpider full-disallow and a Pinterestbot crawl-delay), so escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) per brief, which rendered pages normally (whatever the 403 trigger is, it does not fire for the extension's real browser context). CHECKED: this is one company on one domain (williams-sonoma.com) covering both the 'Williams Sonoma' cookware-led storefront and the 'Williams Sonoma Home' furniture/decor storefront (same domain, brand-switcher links, shared cart/account/search) - Pet Care was searched across the whole domain, not just the /shop/home/ decor subset the prior Home-Decor pass restricted itself to. NAV CHECKED for a Pets node: main WS top nav (New, Cookware, Cooks' Tools, Cutlery, Electrics, Bakeware, Food, Tabletop & Bar, Home Essentials, Outdoor & Garden, Furniture, Holidays, Gifts) - no Pets item; WS Gifts mega-menu (Gift Crates & Baskets, Gifts By Interest, Gifts By Recipient, Gifts By Occasion) - no pet recipient/interest node; WS Outdoor & Garden (/shop/outdoor/) mega-menu - no pet node (only home-grown/BBQ/garden, chicken coops mentioned in body copy only, not a nav category, not treated as 'pet'); Williams Sonoma Home mega-menu (Furniture, Outdoor, Bedding, Bath, Rugs, Lighting, Art & Decor, Pillows & Throws, Gifts) - no Pets node anywhere, including its own Gifts and Furniture submenus (checked in full, screenshot-verified). FOUND ONE REAL NODE: Home Essentials (/shop/homekeeping/) > Kitchen & Home Storage > 'Pet Food Storage & Supplies' (/shop/homekeeping/pet-food-storage/), a genuine pet-specific leaf category, confirmed via real left-nav (not search). QTY: page's own rendered '15 Items' header, read directly off the PLP, 2026-09-02. COMPOSITION (recorded, not sub-filtered - PLP-level extraction, one qty for the whole leaf): the 15 items are Yamazaki Pet Food Bowl, Honeycomb Porcelain Pet Bowls, simplehuman Pet Food Containers (2 sizes), 7x MacKenzie-Childs Pet Bowls (different checks/colors, each its own product-family tile), Dash Dog Treat Maker, Williams Sonoma Best Buddy Dog Treats, and two Miele Cat & Dog canister vacuums. SITE SEARCH IS UNRELIABLE - PROVEN, NOT ASSUMED: searched 'pet' (208 results, mostly the pet-food-storage items above plus unrelated products like SMEG refrigerators and a Dog's Table book) and 'dog bed' (200 results - same flat ballpark count, and the actual results were generic beds/doormats/cookie-cutters/loveseats with zero real dog beds), confirming WS site search returns non-discriminating results and cannot be used as evidence of absence or presence; relied on real category navigation instead, as required. No dog/cat beds, crates, kennels, leashes, collars, carriers, toys, grooming or litter categories exist anywhere on the site.
